name: Singer and guitarist for a private party: Tejas Singh live-looping No Woman No Cry
seoTitle: Tejas Singh live-looping No Woman No Cry at a party
description: Tejas Singh builds No Woman No Cry from the ground up with live looping. He's one musician with a loop pedal, recording each part as he plays it.
more: No Woman No Cry is a Bob Marley song, and Three Little Birds is on his song list, too. The list goes from dinner songs to dance floor favorites, with Into the Mystic, Landslide, Valerie and Mr. Brightside along the way. Requests are welcome, and he can usually learn a song that isn't on the list, such as your first dance.
